QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND` (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:2142`) marks secrets as undefined, so memcheck reports any branch or address that depends on them. ... `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN` does the same with clang's MemorySanitizer.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names the valgrind and MSan constant-flow testing, but it never says the facility is off by default, separate, or explicitly not part of the library API.
